summary: Iteration 6 full test pass: (1) Communication API — GET /communication/status returns {sms:false, whatsapp:false, email:false}; POST /orders/{id}/notify with SMS/WhatsApp returns 200 + result.status='not_configured' + E.164 normalized to (e.g. +4915112345678) + creates communications log entry visible via GET /orders/{id}/communications. Email without customer_email returns 400. Invalid channel and empty message return 400. (2) Order lock fields (device_lock_type, device_passcode, is_reclamation, reclamation_of, reclamation_of_number) accepted and persisted; verified via GET /orders/{id}. (3) IMEI conditional 400 regression holds. (4) Techniker cost/signature/PII fully stripped. Backend pytest: 12/12 PASS. Frontend Playwright: 40/42 PASS (2 non-issues explained below). All 6 feature areas verified: filter tabs incl. filter-tab-fertig, terminology Arbeitskosten/Materialkosten replaces Arbeitslohn/Ersatzteilkosten on /auftrag/neu, 3-mode device lock (none/pattern/pin/password), 3x3 pattern-lock builds sequence + reset works, strict validation blocks submit until all required + pricing fields filled, Reklamation flow (open-reklamation on ABGEHOLT only → banner + prefill customer/device/pricing=0 → creates order with reclamation-badge), CommunicationPanel with 3 channels + not-configured hint + email subject reveal + comms-list append, techniker denied comm-panel/reklamation/invoice/cost.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py is now ~1300 lines. Time to split into separate routers: orders.py, communication.py, invoice.py, media.py, chat.py. The single-file router is becoming a maintenance risk.
messaging.py cleanly separates provider config from send functions and always returns a structured result dict with 'status' — good graceful-fallback pattern. Nice.
CommunicationPanel + PatternLock components have proper data-testid coverage across dots, sequence, reset — testability is excellent.

OrderCreate.validate() considers empty string as invalid for pricing but accepts '0' — this matches the requirement (0 allowed for reclamation) and is correctly used to prefill reclamation with '0'. Good.
Minor: notify_customer returns {**entry, 'result': result} where entry contains _id popped — clean. The prior insert_one ObjectId mutation bug (mentioned in agent context) is confirmed fixed.

Frontend PatternLock displays sequence with ' → ' separator on-screen but sends dash-joined string on submit (via prop callback). Behavioral spec (backend stores '1-2-3-6-9') is honored; test assertion for '1-2-3-6-9' textContent was incorrect (arrow separators used for readability). Not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (40/42 — 2 are false alarms in test assertions, not app bugs)
